purpose: Correct an implementation-level hardware asymmetry discovered by source inspection before any scientific timing: current aarch64 PMULL acceleration exists in rho but not in the Stage99 rank examples. The common port makes the known available carryless-product acceleration available to both IC variants and rho.

observations: The Stage99 rank examples expose only an x86 PCLMUL path.

The rho source includes guarded aarch64 carryless_product_pmull using vmull_p64 with #[target_feature(enable="aes")] and is_aarch64_feature_detected!("aes") at the inspected raw field multiplication and squaring paths.
On the current Darwin arm64 host, allowing that acceleration only to rho would make the planned goal comparison hardware-asymmetric.
evidence.basis: This amendment follows code inspection before a scientific outcome. It is not selected from a timing result.

approved_common_port.permitted_change: Add the guarded aarch64 PMULL carryless-product helper to both rank examples and route mul_raw_dispatched and square_raw_dispatched through it on available ARM hardware. Route rho raw_mul_field and raw_square through the same PMULL backend on available ARM hardware. Preserve existing portable and x86 fallback behavior.
approved_common_port.required_guard: The ARM PMULL path is compiled and called only under the equivalent aarch64 target-feature and runtime is_aarch64_feature_detected!("aes") guards. A host that does not satisfy the guard uses the existing portable or x86 path.
approved_common_port.backend_reporting: Every build, preflight receipt, and scientific receipt must report the actual field-arithmetic backend selected for its process, including whether PMULL was available and used.
mathematical_invariants: Stage99 mathematical algorithms, CLI forms, target construction, dataflow, reduction, relation logic, rank logic, and receipt semantics remain unchanged.
The baseline IC and allocation-only IC sources receive the identical common ARM port.
source_arm_allocation differs from source_arm only by the already approved conditional unused full_pairs allocation: retain historical capacity for PairMode::Full and use capacity zero otherwise.
No source/old timing is a decisive rho baseline and no prior generic build, candidate, control, or failed-attempt artifact is deleted, replaced, or pooled into a result.

source_custody: Root freezes the donor file paths, immutable parent source hash, exact common-port diff, source_arm hash, source_arm_allocation hash, generated dependency lockfiles, compiler/toolchain closure, and all binary hashes before an untimed or scientific process is launched.
The executor may write only source_arm/ and source_arm_allocation/ after this amendment is committed; the immutable original source and all earlier generic sources/builds remain read-only evidence.
correctness_controls: For every common-ported multiplication and squaring entry point, compare PMULL output with an independent software carryless-product reference on edge values, including zero, one, all-one limb patterns, single-bit limbs, maximal field representatives, and cross-limb carries.
Run deterministic n=13 and n=53 field inputs through both PMULL and independent software references for multiplication and squaring, and retain input/output/digest records.
Run the existing mathematical self-tests and record both passed tests and architecture-gated exclusions without claiming excluded x86-only tests ran on arm64.
Audit that x86 PCLMUL and portable fallback code is unchanged except for mechanically necessary shared backend-dispatch plumbing, and record that audit against the exact diff.
pre_timing_admission_gate.failure_rule: Any arithmetic mismatch, backend-reporting absence, source-closure mismatch, altered algorithm/dataflow finding, or failed mathematical self-test refuses both attempt-3 and all scientific execution. It is an implementation finding, not evidence about the ECDLP or the IC mechanism.

attempt_3_binding.rule: The already admitted three attempt-3 logical controls do not launch against the older generic sources. After this amendment's pre-timing admission gate passes, those same three controls run once in their existing fresh attempt3 directories using source_arm baseline IC, source_arm_allocation IC, and source_arm rho respectively.
attempt_3_binding.unchanged_case: N=13, a=0, eta=1/2, seed=13001, explicit public scalar=17, serial one-thread execution, disabled direct support-expansion paths, full proof checks, and no timing/CPU/RSS/profiling/winner analysis.
attempt_3_binding.equivalence_requirement: The ARM baseline/candidate IC control receipts must meet the existing exact mathematical receipt-equivalence requirement. The rho control must independently verify the same public known answer.

unchanged: all 96 targets, scalar list, seed derivation, order, calibration/held-out split, eta panel, selection rule, threshold, cold-start boundary, process seriality, and resource rules
no shared logs/state, batching, imported/public-unknown/private targets, private-key recovery, or cryptanalytic claim
finite claim ceiling and independent review requirement
scientific_boundary.science_hold: All 96 scientific children remain refused until this common-port source closure and correctness gate, the ARM-bound attempt-3 receipts, and all existing committed admission requirements are complete.

claim_effect: None. The amendment authorizes a common correctness-gated hardware implementation port only. It makes no performance, mathematical, asymptotic, security, or cryptanalytic assertion.
